title: Get a damaged tool back in lending
trigger: A tool is found damaged, when it comes back from a loan or at any other time.
result: The tool is repaired and available to borrow again.
notes: TL-BO05 times this journey: from the damage report (Damage reported) to the repair (Tool repaired). Between the two the work passes from whoever found the damage to the librarian who fixes it, and nobody is told the tool is waiting: the step "The librarian sees the tools waiting for repair" carries out no use case yet. That wait is where the median days are lost. The path found outside a return replaces the first two steps, then goes on from the wait for repair.

title: Borrow a tool and bring it back
trigger: A member wants a tool for a job.
result: The tool is back on the shelf, on time, ready for the next member.
notes: TL-BO02 "Tools back on time" depends on what happens while the loan runs, and nothing does: no one reminds the member the loan is due, and a member who needs longer cannot renew it. Both steps carry out no use case or policy yet. The path needs it longer comes after the reminder, then goes on to the return.

title: Bring a new neighbor to their first loan
trigger: A neighbor signs up at the desk.
notes: A welcome when a member is registered could carry them to the shelf sooner; it is a candidate, not a need.
